description: This file defines a class 'Fixer' within the Opencart system that handles currency conversion using the Fixer.io API. It includes methods to fetch latest currency rates, update currency values in the database, and clear cache, primarily used for currency exchange rate updates in an OpenCart module.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: A controller class that updates currency exchange rates via the Fixer.io API.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from Fixer.io API and updates the currency values in the database to keep exchange rates current.
